problems: Channel logic reuses the CASE from public.london_daily_covers_base (read this run via pg_get_viewdef): 'web' = Booking Widget, any '%landing page%', Nav CTA, Hero CTA, Menu Page, Website, 'PPC%', popup, edm; 'gr' = Google Reserve Integration; 'walk' = Walk In; 'recep' = '%reception%' or DSL Host, plus 'Reservation Team' / 'Reservations Team' (the USA reservations desks, which the view's two-capitalised-words staff regex would otherwise swallow). The 'ot' slot is the USA platform: Open Table, OpenTable, OTGC, OT Guestcenter, OT and Resy. 'tp' holds the partner sources DoorDash, Bilt Integration and Flaming Duck Miami. Filters: is_deleted = false, status_simple <> 'Canceled', venue_seating_area_name NOT ILIKE '%bar%', metric SUM(covers) by booking-created date in America/New_York, sargable range predicates on sr_created_at with both ends bounded and one date window per query.

Staff-name booking sources are EXCLUDED from the covers total entirely, as in prior weeks: the view's two-capitalised-words regex with its keyword exclusion list, plus the lower-case and single-name USA staff entries ('andrew sicklin', 'Luz', 'Lucilly', 'Tracey', 'Wendy') and 'Imported Reservations'. 'Flaming Duck Miami' matches the staff regex but is a partner source, so it is forced into 'tp' ahead of the staff test.
